items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: Billy Eckstine was with Basie... Lester came out and said, 'You give me a hard time.' We grabbed each other... I said, 'Man, I'm glad for you.'

ctx.x: band. I think that was back in the late 50's... Yeah, it was around there. Just a little before the 60's, Billy Eckstine was with Basie, and they had come down through here. And Lester came out and said, "You give me a hard time." We grabbed each other and was rasslin'around out there in the back of the dance hall. We got through talking and everything, and I said, "Man, I'm glad for you." So Basie eased up to me, and told me, "Man, he doesn't blow his top(?). That cat there, he's something else."
